subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the hardcover board book "小熊的月亮船" whose cover design and interior watercolor illustrations come from <Picture 1>. The front cover features a soft teal-blue night sky dotted with golden five-pointed stars and mint-green clouds; a fluffy brown bear wearing a red scarf sits inside a golden-yellow crescent moon boat holding a wooden oar; a small lit lantern hangs from the boat's bow; a castle silhouette glows in the distance; the title "小熊的月亮船" is printed in rounded warm lettering at the top; the spine is cream-yellow with vertical title text; "童心出版社" appears at the bottom of the cover. Interior pages show hand-painted watercolor illustrations: the bear rowing the moon boat across a star-reflecting sea, and the bear sitting among fluffy clouds surrounded by smiling star characters near a cloud castle. The pages are thick cardboard with rounded corners.
<Subject 2> is the warm-lit children's bedroom setting with a wooden bed dressed in soft cream and sage-green bedding, a warm-yellow bedside lamp casting a gentle glow, light wood furniture, and a bookshelf with soft toys in the background, all under shallow depth of field.
<Subject 3> is a gentle-looking young woman aged 25 to 30 with light makeup, long wavy hair, and a cream-colored knit cardigan over a soft top, wearing a warm, approachable smile. She is the on-screen speaker whose mouth movements and jaw motion are fully synchronized syllable-by-syllable with the driving audio track (口型与驱动音频逐音节同步).
<Subject 4> is a toddler aged 3 to 5 wearing soft light-colored pajamas.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] The target video is a 15-second live-action e-commerce promotional video for the children's board book <Subject 1>. <Subject 3> sits in <Subject 2>, presents the book cover to camera, opens it to show the thick rounded-corner pages and watercolor illustrations, reads it to <Subject 4> in a warm bedtime scene, then closes the book and recommends it directly to the lens. The driving audio track supplies the complete spoken script and <Subject 3> lip-syncs every syllable in real time (口型与驱动音频逐音节同步). <Picture 1> supplies the book cover art, bear character design, watercolor interior illustration style, cream spine, and physical page thickness that must remain identical across every shot.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - the cover illustration, title typography, brown bear with red scarf, golden crescent moon boat, wooden oar, hanging lantern, golden stars, mint-green clouds, cream-yellow spine, hand-painted watercolor interior artwork, thick board pages, and rounded corners are retained in every shot where the book is visible.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - the warm children's bedroom, bedside lamp, cream and sage-green bedding, light wood furniture, and soft-toy bookshelf background are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - the young woman's age range, long wavy hair, light makeup, cream knit cardigan, and warm smile are consistent across all shots; her on-screen speech is lip-synced syllable-by-syllable with the driving audio.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the toddler's age range and soft light pajamas are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a live-action e-commerce promotional video with warm indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, and a cozy, healing bedtime atmosphere. All on-screen speech by <Subject 3> is synchronized syllable-by-syllable with the driving audio track (口型与驱动音频逐音节同步), with natural mouth opening and closing, gentle jaw movement, and accurate lip shaping for each Chinese syllable.
[Shot 1] A medium shot frames <Subject 3>, the young woman in the cream knit cardigan, seated in <Subject 2> the warm-lit children's bedroom. She holds <Subject 1>, the hardcover board book, up with both hands so the front cover faces the camera directly. The cover shows the fluffy brown bear with a red scarf inside the golden crescent moon boat under the teal starry sky, matching the design in <Picture 1>; the title "小熊的月亮船" is clearly legible at the top. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the book cover. <Subject 3> (S1) looks into the lens with a warm smile and begins speaking, her lips parting naturally with each syllable, her jaw dropping slightly on open vowels and closing on consonants: <d>[Chinese]宝宝睡前总兴奋？读《小熊的月亮船》。</d> Her mouth keeps moving in precise rhythm with the driving audio, never drifting out of sync.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of <Subject 3> lowering the book and gently opening <Subject 1> with both hands. Thick cardboard pages with rounded corners spread open, revealing the hand-painted watercolor interior illustrations: the bear rowing the moon boat across a star-reflecting sea, and the bear sitting among fluffy clouds with smiling star characters. Her fingers turn one page slowly and naturally. <Subject 3> (S1) continues speaking while looking down at the open pages, her lips continuing to form each Chinese syllable in sync with the driving audio, jaw moving gently: <scenetrans><d>[Chinese]小熊坐月亮船，慢慢说晚安。</d> The voice continues uninterrupted across the cut.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cross-dissolves to a medium shot of the same bedroom at night. The warm bedside lamp glows on the nightstand. <Subject 3> sits on the edge of the bed with <Subject 4>, the toddler in soft light pajamas, leaning against her chest. She holds the open <Subject 1> in her lap and gently points at the illustration on the page with one finger. The toddler reaches out a small hand toward the golden stars and moon boat drawn on the book page. <Subject 3> (S1) reads softly to the child while also looking toward the camera, her mouth continuing to move naturally with each syllable — lips rounded on "yuán" and "bǎn", jaw relaxed on soft vowels — fully in sync with the driving audio: <scenetrans><d>[Chinese]圆角厚纸板，环保油墨，两至六岁放心读。</d> The voice continues seamlessly across the transition.
[Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the camera cuts back to a medium shot of <Subject 3> seated at a light wooden table. She closes <Subject 1> with both hands and sets it flat on the table, then turns to face the camera directly with a warm, reassuring smile. To the right of the book on the table, a stack of matching children's picture books and a small gift box are visible. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed, gradually widening the frame and leaving empty negative space in the upper portion of the screen for on-screen selling-point text. <Subject 3> (S1) speaks directly to camera, her lips parting and closing with clear, deliberate syllables, jaw moving gently with each phrase, fully lip-synced to the driving audio: <scenetrans><d>[Chinese]今晚，陪他坐上月亮船。点下方带回家。</d> The voice carries through to the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
Soft indoor room tone continues throughout the video. Thick cardboard pages rustle softly as the book is opened, turned, and closed. A child's faint, contented breathing is audible during the bedtime reading scene.

non_diegetic_music:
A gentle lullaby-style instrumental at a slow tempo, featuring soft music-box-like piano notes over sustained warm string pads, with subtle glockenspiel twinkles that evoke stardust, mixed low beneath the spoken voice and fading gently under the final line.
